--kit-accent-soft.reason: The amber tint behind a selected or hovered row. The kit's accent/accent-soft (light). Neither the shared paper layer nor argus-ui's theme.css names it, so there is nothing to compare it with; Tares keeps the kit value.

--kit-dark-accent-soft.reason: The dark-mode twin of --kit-accent-soft (the kit's accent/accent-soft, dark). Same reason.
